neighbours.label: the particle or preposition that completes a phase/part phrase ('kicked off', 'start of', 'part of', 'left off', 'after finishing')
fire: The mayor kicked off the festival with a short speech in the square.
The alarm went off at the start of the second lesson.
Good sleep is a big part of staying healthy through the winter.
Open the book and keep reading right where you left off yesterday.
Many graduates travel for a year after finishing their degrees.
The lights failed during the final minutes of the concert.
She was proud of her son for taking his first steps on his own.
The rain stopped just before the end of the match.
quiet: The mayor gave a short speech to the crowd in the square.
The alarm went off loudly in the second classroom.
Good sleep is very important for staying healthy through the winter.
Open the book and keep reading the chapter you liked yesterday.
Many graduates travel for a year with their old friends.
The lights failed suddenly in the crowded concert hall.
She was proud of her son and told all her friends about him.
The rain stopped just before the players came out.
